user.title: Pill Blister
user.description: Set up the blister. Take the intake window from the package leaflet: how much earlier or later an intake still counts for its day.

data_description.name: Whose pill. Entities are called “[name] Pill …”.
data_description.dose_time: The time the pill is usually taken.
data_description.blister_start: Day pill 1 of the current blister was taken.
data_description.person: Passed along in events, e.g. for notifications.
data_description.window_before: An intake this much earlier still counts for that day.
data_description.window_after: An intake this much later still counts for that day, also after midnight. Outside every window you are asked which day it belongs to.
data_description.on_time: Deviation that still counts as on time (only for display).

missed.title: Missed pill (package leaflet)
missed.description: Enter what your package leaflet says. Nothing is pre-filled: the integration only shows notices based on these rules and never states that protection exists.

data.multi_days: Several missed in one blister: extra contraception (days)

data_description.missed_after: Hours after the intake time from which a pill counts as missed (later or not at all).

illness.title: Vomiting, diarrhoea & co.
illness.description: Optional: events that can make a pill ineffective. Leave the name empty to finish.

data_description.within_hours: An event up to this many hours after the intake affects the pill.
data_description.replacement_hours: Hours after the intake until which a replacement pill cancels the event. 0 = not possible.

error.window_too_long: Window before and after together must be shorter than 24 hours.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up.
